name: Выгрузка с Superset - Партии и остатки -> Supabase

parameters.content: Получение токена по логину и паролю
Получение дополнительных данных (данные сессии) для подключения

Запись в Supabase:
новые строки добавляются, изменившиеся обновляются,
исчезнувшие из выгрузки удаляются

parameters.query:
with src as (
  select
    r->>'row_key'         as row_key,
    r->>'batch_id'        as batch_id,
    r->>'batch_number'    as batch_number,
    r->>'batch_barcode'   as batch_barcode,
    r->>'cell_key'        as cell_key,
    r->>'sku_id'          as sku_id,
    r->>'sku_title'       as sku_title,
    r->>'invoice_id'      as invoice_id,
    nullif(r->>'invoice_date','')::date as invoice_date,
    r->>'gtd_number'      as gtd_number,
    r->>'gtd_kind'        as gtd_kind,
    nullif(r->>'gtd_date','')::date     as gtd_date,
    nullif(r->>'expiry_date','')::date  as expiry_date,
    nullif(r->>'is_return','')::boolean as is_return,
    r->>'stock_status'    as stock_status,
    r->>'zone_title'      as zone_title,
    r->>'zone_purpose'    as zone_purpose,
    r->>'zone_stock_type' as zone_stock_type,
    coalesce(nullif(r->>'amount','')::int, 0)         as amount,
    coalesce(nullif(r->>'amount_pending','')::int, 0) as amount_pending,
    nullif(r->>'volume_m3','')::numeric               as volume_m3,
    coalesce(nullif(r->>'rows_merged','')::smallint, 1) as rows_merged,
    nullif(r->>'query_day','')::date  as query_day,
    md5(concat_ws('|',
          coalesce(r->>'cell_key',''), coalesce(r->>'stock_status',''),
          coalesce(r->>'zone_title',''), coalesce(r->>'zone_purpose',''),
          coalesce(r->>'zone_stock_type',''), coalesce(r->>'amount','0'),
          coalesce(r->>'amount_pending','0'), coalesce(r->>'volume_m3',''),
          coalesce(r->>'expiry_date',''), coalesce(r->>'gtd_number',''),
          coalesce(r->>'sku_title',''), coalesce(r->>'batch_number',''))) as payload_hash
  from jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) as r
),
gone as (
  delete from public.ecom_batch_stock t
   where not exists (select 1 from src s where s.row_key = t.row_key)
)
insert into public.ecom_batch_stock as t
  (row_key, batch_id, batch_number, batch_barcode, cell_key, sku_id, sku_title,
   invoice_id, invoice_date, gtd_number, gtd_kind, gtd_date, expiry_date, is_return,
   stock_status, zone_title, zone_purpose, zone_stock_type,
   amount, amount_pending, volume_m3, rows_merged, query_day, payload_hash)
select
   row_key, batch_id, batch_number, batch_barcode, cell_key, sku_id, sku_title,
   invoice_id, invoice_date, gtd_number, gtd_kind, gtd_date, expiry_date, is_return,
   stock_status, zone_title, zone_purpose, zone_stock_type,
   amount, amount_pending, volume_m3, rows_merged, query_day, payload_hash
from src
on conflict (row_key) do update set
  batch_number    = excluded.batch_number,
  batch_barcode   = excluded.batch_barcode,
  cell_key        = excluded.cell_key,
  sku_title       = excluded.sku_title,
  invoice_id      = excluded.invoice_id,
  invoice_date    = excluded.invoice_date,
  gtd_number      = excluded.gtd_number,
  gtd_kind        = excluded.gtd_kind,
  gtd_date        = excluded.gtd_date,
  expiry_date     = excluded.expiry_date,
  is_return       = excluded.is_return,
  stock_status    = excluded.stock_status,
  zone_title      = excluded.zone_title,
  zone_purpose    = excluded.zone_purpose,
  zone_stock_type = excluded.zone_stock_type,
  amount          = excluded.amount,
  amount_pending  = excluded.amount_pending,
  volume_m3       = excluded.volume_m3,
  rows_merged     = excluded.rows_merged,
  query_day       = excluded.query_day,
  payload_hash    = excluded.payload_hash,
  changed_at      = now()
where t.payload_hash is distinct from excluded.payload_hash;
